full_prompt_en: A square natural-history botanical painting shows a spotted moth resting on a large pink flower amid dense leaves, buds, and smaller insects. The flower dominates the left and central foreground. Its many layered petals open in broad rose and blush folds, with darker crimson shadows near the base and pale highlights along the upper rims. The moth spreads its patterned cream-and-black wings across the flower's top, with a dark turquoise body and fine antennae visible between them. Behind the blossom, deep olive leaves overlap with stems, unopened buds, and a pale fuzzy seed head. A large cream-white flower reaches in from the upper-left corner, its yellow stamens finely drawn. Scattered orange and dark insects appear among the upper foliage, while small pale blossoms punctuate the lower edges. The background is a muted blue-green field that gives the crowded plants depth without becoming a separate landscape. Every natural surface receives close attention: leaf veins, petal edges, pollen-like points, wing spots, and fine hairs are carefully articulated. Yet the arrangement remains painterly, with gentle tonal washes linking forms rather than a flat specimen diagram. Soft daylight from the upper left illuminates the pink petals and white flower, while overlapping leaves create cool green shadows below and behind them. Warm coral and cream flowers stand forward against the dark foliage and blue-green ground. No labels or readable text appear. The overall composition is lavish and closely observed, using one broad blossom and its winged visitor to organize a richly textured botanical thicket.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形自然史植物绘画描绘一只斑纹飞蛾停在大朵粉花上，周围有密集叶片、花苞和小昆虫。花朵主导左侧与中央前景。层层叠叠的花瓣以宽阔玫瑰色和胭脂粉褶面打开，根部有较深深红阴影，上缘带浅亮部。飞蛾把奶油色与黑色花纹翅膀展开在花顶，翅间可见深绿松石色身体和细触角。花后，深橄榄叶与枝茎、未开花苞及浅色绒毛状种子头相互重叠。一朵大的奶油白花从左上角伸入，黄色花蕊描绘精细。零散橙色和深色昆虫出现在上方叶间，小浅花点缀下方边缘。背景是柔和蓝绿色域，赋予拥挤植物纵深，却不成为另一幅风景。每种自然表面都受到细致关注：叶脉、花瓣边、花粉般小点、翅斑和细毛被谨慎刻画。然而布局仍保有绘画感，温和明暗薄涂把形体相连，而非平板标本图。柔和日光从左上方照亮粉花瓣和白花，重叠叶片在其下后方形成冷绿阴影。暖珊瑚与奶油色花朵从深叶和蓝绿底面前浮出。没有标签或可读文字。整体构图丰盛而观察细密，以一朵宽大花和停驻其上的有翅生物组织肌理丰富的植物密丛。
style_prompt_en: Natural-history botanical painting combines meticulous contour detail with soft tonal washes and a densely layered arrangement. Rose, coral, cream, olive, and muted blue-green create rich warm-cool interplay, with pale petals emerging from dark leaves. Fine veins, spots, hairs, and pollen-like points reward close viewing, while larger overlapping shapes hold the crowded image together. Diffuse daylight lifts upper surfaces and leaves cool shadow between layers. Edges remain precise around small focal details but soften in the deeper field. The overall effect is lush, tactile, and carefully observed.
style_prompt_zh: 自然史植物绘画把细致轮廓细节与柔和明暗薄涂、密集层叠布局结合起来。玫瑰、珊瑚、奶油、橄榄和柔和蓝绿形成丰富冷暖互动，浅花瓣从深叶前浮现。细叶脉、斑点、绒毛和花粉般小点值得近观，较大的重叠形状又把拥挤图像统一起来。漫射日光抬亮上层表面，层间留冷影。小焦点细节周围边缘精确，深处区域逐渐柔化。整体茂盛、可触且观察细密。
theme_en: A spotted moth resting on a large pink flower among dense leaves
theme_zh: 一只斑纹飞蛾停在繁密叶丛中的大朵粉花上
name: Maria Sibylla Merian
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
